column7: azuresource.List wrapped azcore ResponseError with %w, and its Error() text prints the full response body, so a vault, proxy or impersonating endpoint answering GetSecret or the list call with a non-200 status (403/5xx echoing the secret, or a 203/206 carrying the real body) put the secret value into the error keyorix-migrate prints (found by FuzzAzureSourceHostileEndpoint, seed 552c14b2e113ee80); the error now carries the status code only and httpsafe.AzureClient scrubs every non-200 body, as internal/connect does since #4061.
